title: Steak Doneness and Nutrient Retention

scenes.text: Does cooking a steak to medium‑rare keep more nutrients than well‑done?

scenes.label: Rarer steak = healthier
scenes.text: People believe the rarer the steak, the healthier it is.

scenes.label: Nutrients stable across done
scenes.text: Scientific studies show that protein and iron content stay stable across doneness; only minor loss of B‑vitamins occurs with higher heat.

scenes.label: Taste over myth
scenes.sub: Nutrition stays similar, so cook how you enjoy.
scenes.text: Choose doneness for taste, not nutrition.
Follow for your daily dose of vitality.

description: We bust the myth that a rarer steak is automatically healthier. Learn what really changes when you cook meat and how to pick your perfect doneness. Follow for more science‑backed food tips.
